description: Governance-manager integration: wire GovernanceEngine into ContextManager so all governance-gated operations are exclusively routed through the engine with no bypass.

stories.title: Store GovernanceEngine in PerContextState and construct in builder
stories.description: Add a `governance_engine: Box<dyn GovernanceEngine>` field to `PerContextState` in manager.rs. In the builder (`create_context`), construct the appropriate engine variant based on `ContextParams::governance_model` (`GovernanceModelConfig`): `SingleAdmin` -> `SingleAdminEngine`, `Threshold` -> `ThresholdEngine`, `Majority` -> `MajorityVoteEngine`, `Unanimity` -> `UnanimityEngine`. The builder.rs placeholder at line 416 ('ContextParams always has a governance field, so this is a placeholder for future governance model validation') should be replaced with actual engine construction. The engine is immutable for the context's lifetime (per ADR-031 line 2314). Re-export `GovernanceModelConfig` from context/mod.rs if not already exported.

stories.title: Expose propose/approve/reject/withdraw on ContextManager
stories.description: Add public methods on ContextManager that delegate to the stored GovernanceEngine: `propose_governance_action()`, `approve_governance_proposal()`, `reject_governance_proposal()`, `withdraw_governance_vote()`. Each method acquires the per-context lock, retrieves the engine, constructs a GovernanceContext snapshot from PerContextState, delegates to the engine's corresponding method, and records the governance event in the event log. The propose method validates that the proposer holds `GovernancePropose` capability (UCAN). The approve/reject methods validate that the voter holds `GovernanceVote` capability. Per ADR-031 line 2564, SingleAdmin.propose() simultaneously creates and approves. Per sketch.md §6, these are the three-method mandatory protocol contract. When a proposal reaches `Approved` status after a vote, the manager automatically calls `execute_governance_action()` (from SCP-253).

stories.title: Wire all GovernanceAction variants through execute_governance_action
stories.description:
Extend `execute_governance_action()` to handle all GovernanceAction variants, not just BlockAuthor (which was wired in PR #243). For each variant, implement the internal execution method and add a corresponding GovernanceActionResult variant. Remove or restrict any standalone public methods that bypass governance. Specifically: `close_context()` must route through governance for multi-admin models (SingleAdmin can still close directly via auto-approve). All GovernanceAction variants listed in ADR-031 must have execution paths. The catch-all arm that returns PermissionDenied('not yet supported') must be replaced with actual dispatch.

GovernanceAction variants to wire: AddMember, RemoveMember, ChangeRole, RegisterTool, RemoveTool, ModifyCeiling, CloseContext, ExtendTtl, TransferAdmin, CreateChildContext. BlockAuthor is already wired. Per ADR-031 line 2591, ExtendTtl and PromoteContext always require unanimity regardless of the context's governance model — this override is enforced by the ContextManager.

Key constraint from Alec: all governed actions MUST be exclusively available through GovernanceEngine. No standalone bypass methods. The engine cannot be circumvented.
acceptanceCriteria: execute_governance_action() dispatches all GovernanceAction variants (no catch-all 'not supported' arm)

GovernanceActionResult has variants for each action type (MemberAdded, MemberRemoved, RoleChanged, ToolRegistered, ToolRemoved, CeilingModified, ContextClosed, TtlExtended, AdminTransferred, ChildContextCreated, AuthorBlocked)

close_context() for SingleAdmin still works (auto-approve) but goes through the engine

No standalone public method on ContextManager directly executes a governance-gated operation without going through the engine

stories.title: Implement governance proposal timeout task
stories.description: Implement the GovernanceTimeoutTask specified in ADR-031 §5. The SDK runs a background task that checks active proposals every 60 seconds. When a proposal's voting_deadline passes without resolution, the task calls resolve() which transitions the proposal to Expired or Rejected (model-specific rules). The timeout task also handles: proposer departure (Pending -> Invalidated), voter departure (vote removed, quorum recalculated), and epoch reset (votes invalidated per ADR-029 Tier 3). The task runs per-context and is started when the context enters Active state. It stops when the context is closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Background task checks all active proposals in a context on a 60-second interval
Expired proposals (now > voting_deadline) transition to Expired or Rejected per model-specific rules

Voter departure removes their vote and recalculates quorum (may change resolution)
Epoch reset (ADR-029 Tier 3) invalidates affected votes on pending proposals

Task stops when context is closed or dropped

stories.title: Governance-manager integration test: full lifecycle across all models
stories.description: Integration test that exercises the full governance lifecycle through ContextManager for all four governance models. Tests context creation with each model, proposal submission, voting, approval/rejection, and action execution. Verifies that governance-gated operations cannot be performed without going through the engine. Verifies event log auditability of all governance operations. This is the comprehensive test that SCP-160 (economic governance integration test) was for economic fields — this is for the core governance-manager wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test creates contexts with each of the four governance models
SingleAdmin: propose auto-approves, action executes immediately
Threshold: propose -> collect M approvals -> action executes
Majority: propose -> collect majority votes -> action executes
Unanimity: propose -> all members approve -> action executes
Rejected proposals do not execute actions
Expired proposals do not execute actions
All governance events appear in the context event log in correct order
Attempting governance-gated operations through non-governance paths returns errors
Test exercises at least 3 different GovernanceAction variants (e.g., RemoveMember, ChangeRole, CloseContext)
